svg.title: A fleet from goal to done
svg.desc: Animated diagram. In your session, /fleet writes the definition of fleet site-docs and marks it ready. mike opens one docs template, which reads and closes, then workers for T1 (install.md) and T2 (quickstart.md), copied from it, while T3 (the link check) waits. T1 and T2 commit to one branch, mike checks each commit and the judge passes both, so T3 starts. When T3 passes, every task is accepted and the fleet is done.
svg.text: One goal, three tasks, one branch

g.text: In your own Claude Code session, /fleet writes the goal, the criteria
and three tasks, then marks the fleet ready.
No session is in charge. mike runs a loop every 20 seconds
and three short model calls: judge, checker, problem-solver.
One template for the docs work
The docs template reads the rules, its reading list and the definition,
then its pane closes. It never works on a task.
Workers open for T1 and T2
Each worker is copied from the template, so the reading is already done.
T3 waits until T1 and T2 have passed.
Each worker commits only its own file with fleet_commit and reports.
mike runs the check on each commit. The judge reads the diff
against the criteria and passes T1 and T2.
T3 starts on the next round
Within 20 seconds of the second pass, mike opens a worker for T3.
Every task accepted: the fleet is done
T3 commits and passes. mike closes the panes, writes the run record
